claims.text: Hokusai’s color woodblock design The Great Wave presents boats beneath a breaking wave, with Mount Fuji visible in the distance.
The Met and Tokyo Fuji Art Museum give about 1830–1832; the range estimates publication, not a continuous two-year printing operation.
The print belongs to Thirty-six Views of Mount Fuji. Its blue palette combines indigo with imported Prussian blue, linking Japanese printmaking to traded pigments.

review.corroboration: The Met and Tokyo Fuji Art Museum catalogue dates agree at about 1830–32. They describe separate impressions of the same design.
